sv.title: Oro i Kenya – dödsfall hos flodhästar utreds
sv.summary: Kenya utreder flera händelser där flodhästar tros ha dött efter att ha fått i sig olämplig föda. Mängden fall på kort tid oroar landets naturvårdsmyndighet.

en.title: Concern in Kenya – hippo deaths under investigation
en.summary: Kenya is investigating several incidents in which hippos are believed to have died after ingesting unsuitable food. The number of cases in a short period is worrying the country's environmental protection agency.
